title: CSRF, Client-State Manipulation and Privilege Escalation Detection
goal: Gruyere has three related vulnerabilities that AegisPT currently cannot detect: (1) CSRF on /deletesnippet — state-changing GET endpoint with no CSRF token; (2) Client-state manipulation / Elevation of Privilege — POST /saveprofile accepts is_admin=True without server-side authorization check; (3) Cookie manipulation — account creation with special characters in username creates malformed cookie that can be parsed as admin. These require an authenticated session context (auth-flow must run first) and targeted parameter injection. Extend the client_state runner to: (a) detect state-changing GET endpoints with no CSRF protection (look for actions like delete, update, admin in URLs accessible via GET without token); (b) inject hidden privilege parameters (is_admin=True, role=admin, admin=1, is_superuser=True) into discovered POST forms and check if the response confirms elevated access; (c) test cookie parsing edge cases by creating test accounts with | and special characters and verifying if the session is mis-parsed. These tests require an active session — gate them behind authentication context from auth-flow.
generation_reason: Gruyere's CSRF on /deletesnippet and EoP via is_admin=True in POST /saveprofile are not detected. The client_state runner does not test for privilege parameter injection or CSRF on GET endpoints.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.authorized_only: Only run against authorized targets within approved scope. Never test against live production systems without explicit authorization.
constraints.no_destructive_actions: Do not delete real data. For CSRF tests, use GET-only probes. For EoP tests, check response for admin indicators but do not persist changes.
constraints.scope_enforcement: All test URLs must pass web_target_value_is_allowed_with_path() check.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep implementation bounded to this task package. Defer broader scanner, exploit-chain, UI, or runtime work to separately queued packages.

implementation_notes.csrf_detection: Find all discovered endpoints where the HTTP method is GET but the URL contains action-words (delete, remove, update, admin, reset, change). Check if a request without a CSRF token succeeds (2xx/3xx response). Report as finding if no token validation occurs.
implementation_notes.eop_detection: For each discovered POST form, add extra fields: is_admin=True, role=admin, admin=1, privilege=admin. Check if the response body or a subsequent GET to the profile endpoint shows admin-level content. Use string matching: 'admin', 'is_admin', 'administrator', 'privileged'.
implementation_notes.cookie_manipulation: Test account creation with username containing pipe |, null bytes, and path traversal sequences ../. Check if the resulting session cookie contains unexpected privilege indicators.
